content.text:
Please analyze this codebase and create a CLAUDE.md file, which will be given to future instances of Claude Code to operate in this repository.

What to add:
1. Commands that will be commonly used, such as how to build, lint, and run tests. Include the necessary commands to develop in this codebase, such as how to run a single test.
2. High-level code architecture and structure so that future instances can be productive more quickly. Focus on the "big picture" architecture that requires reading multiple files to understand.

Usage notes:
- If there's already a CLAUDE.md, suggest improvements to it.
- When you make the initial CLAUDE.md, do not repeat yourself and do not include obvious instructions like "Provide helpful error messages to users", "Write unit tests for all new utilities", "Never include sensitive information (API keys, tokens) in code or commits".
- Avoid listing every component or file structure that can be easily discovered.
- Don't include generic development practices.
- If there are Cursor rules (in .cursor/rules/ or .cursorrules) or Copilot rules (in .github/copilot-instructions.md), make sure to include the important parts.
- If there is a README.md, make sure to include the important parts.
- Do not make up information such as "Common Development Tasks", "Tips for Development", "Support and Documentation" unless this is expressly included in other files that you read.
- Be sure to prefix the file with the following text:

```
# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
```

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

1	# CLAUDE.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Project Overview
6	
7	**Show Command Center** — a trade show project management tool for Exhibitor Services teams at General Service Contractors. Built as a pnpm monorepo with a React frontend, Express backend, and PostgreSQL database.
8	
9	## Common Commands
10	
11	```bash
12	# Build & typecheck
13	pnpm run build                  # Typecheck + build all packages
14	pnpm run typecheck              # Full typecheck across all packages
15	
16	# Development
17	pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev           # Build (esbuild) then start API server (no watch; restart to pick up changes)
18	pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run dev  # Start frontend (Vite HMR)
19	
20	# Database
21	pnpm --filter @workspace/db run generate  # Generate new migration
22	pnpm --filter @workspace/db run migrate   # Apply migrations
23	pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push      # Push schema directly (dev only, no migration file)
24	
25	# API code generation (run after editing lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml)
26	pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen
27	
28	# Testing (requires both servers already running on port 80)
29	pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test              # All Playwright tests
30	pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test:ui           # Playwright UI mode
31	pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test -- --grep "test name"  # Single test by name
32	pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test -- tests/smoke.spec.ts # Single file
33	```
34	
35	## Architecture
36	
37	### Monorepo Layout
38	
39	```
40	artifacts/          # Deployable applications
41	  api-server/       # Express 5 backend
42	  show-command-center/  # React 19 + Vite frontend
43	  mockup-sandbox/   # Component preview tool
44	
45	lib/                # Shared packages
46	  db/               # Drizzle ORM schema & migrations (PostgreSQL)
47	  api-spec/         # OpenAPI spec (source of truth for the API contract)
48	  api-client-react/ # React Query hooks generated from OpenAPI
49	  api-zod/          # Zod schemas generated from OpenAPI
50	```
51	
52	### Data Flow
53	
54	```
55	api-spec/openapi.yaml
56	    → (orval codegen) →
57	api-client-react/ (React Query hooks) + api-zod/ (Zod schemas)
58	    ↑ implemented by ↑
59	api-server/ (Express routes)
60	    ↓ uses ↓
61	db/ (Drizzle ORM + schema → drizzle-zod types)
62	    ↓ uses ↓
63	PostgreSQL 16
64	```
65	
66	### OpenAPI-First Development
67	
68	The API contract lives in `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml`. After modifying it, run `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen` to regenerate:
69	- `lib/api-client-react/src/generated/api.ts` — React Query hooks used in the frontend
70	- `lib/api-zod/src/generated/` — Zod schemas for request/response validation
71	
72	### Frontend Pages
73	
74	| Route | Component | Purpose |
75	|---|---|---|
76	| `/` | Dashboard | Show cards, "Next Up" banner, overdue items |
77	| `/calendar` | Calendar | Monthly view with color-coded show chips |
78	| `/shows/:id` | Show Detail | Tabs: Tasks, E-Blasts, Links |
79	| `/office-tasks` | OfficeTasks | Office-wide task management |
80	
81	### Backend Routes
82	
83	All routes are under `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/`: `/shows`, `/shows/:showId/tasks`, `/shows/:showId/eblasts`, `/shows/:showId/links`, `/calendar`, `/dashboard/summary`, `/dashboard/overdue`, `/office-tasks`, `/venues`, `/export`.
84	
85	The `/export` route returns ICS (iCalendar) format for importing shows into calendar apps.
86	
87	## Environment Variables
88	
89	| Variable | Required by |
90	|---|---|
91	| `DATABASE_URL` | API server + DB migrations |
92	| `PORT` | Vite frontend dev server |
93	| `BASE_PATH` | Vite frontend base path |
94	| `NODE_ENV` | API server |
95	
96	## Key Conventions
97	
98	- **Package manager**: pnpm only — a `preinstall` script enforces this.
99	- **Node version**: 24; **TypeScript**: 5.9.
100	- **Zod imports**: Use `zod/v4` — all schemas in this repo import from `"zod/v4"`, not `"zod"`.
101	- **Workspace deps**: Use `workspace:*` to reference local packages.
102	- **DB types**: Drizzle-zod auto-generates Zod schemas from the DB schema; use these rather than writing them by hand.
103	- **UI components**: Radix UI primitives + custom wrappers in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/ui/`.
104	- **Routing**: wouter (not React Router).
105	- **Logging**: Pino with HTTP middleware on the server.
106	
107	## Domain Logic
108	
109	### Urgency System
110	
111	Show urgency is based on days until `moveInDate` (see `getUrgencyInfo` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`):
112	
113	| Days remaining | Color | Label |
114	|---|---|---|
115	| past | Gray | PAST |
116	| 0–7 | Red | URGENT |
117	| 8–13 | Amber | CLOSE |
118	| 14–30 | Yellow | SOON |
119	| 31–60 | Green | IN PROGRESS |
120	| 61+ | Indigo | PLANNING |
121	
122	### Show Archive Logic
123	
124	A show is considered **active** if `dismantleDate ?? moveInDate >= today`; otherwise it is **archived**. There is no explicit archived flag in the DB — the dashboard route computes this dynamically.
125	
126	### DB Schema Key Fields
127	
128	- **shows**: `moveInDate` (required), `dismantleDate`, `advanceWarehouseDate`, `discountDeadline`, `onlineOrderDeadline`, `showStart`, `venue`, `tags` (text array).
129	- **tasks**: completion tracked via `completed` boolean + `completedAt` timestamp; has `category`, `dueDate`, `dueDateRule`, `notes`.
130	- **eblasts**: completion tracked via `sent` boolean + `sentAt` timestamp (not `completed`/`completedAt`); no category field.
131	- **office_tasks**: has `priority` (`low`/`medium`/`high`) and `status` (`todo`/`in-progress`/`done`) fields in addition to `completed`; standalone (no `showId`).
132	- **links**: `title` + `url` only; no completion state.
133	- **venues**: lookup table referenced by `shows.venue` (text, not a foreign key).
134	
135	### Task Categories
136	
137	Tasks belong to one of six hardcoded categories (each has a distinct color and a set of preset templates with calculated due dates):
138	
139	- **Fire Marshal** — deadlines relative to move-in date (calendar and business days)
140	- **ID Sign** — deadlines relative to move-in date
141	- **Warehouse Manifest** — deadlines relative to `advanceWarehouseDate`
142	- **Show Bucket** — deadlines relative to move-in date and `onlineOrderDeadline`
143	- **Vehicle Spotting** — deadlines relative to move-in date
144	- **Electrical** — deadlines relative to `onlineOrderDeadline`
145	
146	The full preset list lives in `task-list.tsx` and `eblast-list.tsx`. Each preset computes a `dueDate` and stores a human-readable `dueDateRule` string (e.g. `"30 biz days before move-in"`) as display text — it is not re-evaluated after creation.
147	
148	Category badge colors come from `getCategoryColor` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`.
149	
150	### Date Parsing
151	
152	Always use `parseDateStr` from `lib/date-utils.ts` to convert `YYYY-MM-DD` strings to `Date` objects. Using `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` directly parses as UTC midnight and shifts the date backward by one day in US timezones.
153	
154	On the server, `sanitizeDates` in the shows route converts empty-string date fields to `null` before writing to the DB.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

**Show Command Center** — a trade show project management tool for Exhibitor Services teams at General Service Contractors. Built as a pnpm monorepo with a React frontend, Express backend, and PostgreSQL database.

## Common Commands

```bash
# Build & typecheck
pnpm run build                  # Typecheck + build all packages
pnpm run typecheck              # Full typecheck across all packages

# Development
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev           # Build (esbuild) then start API server (no watch; restart to pick up changes)
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run dev  # Start frontend (Vite HMR)

# Database
pnpm --filter @workspace/db run generate  # Generate new migration
pnpm --filter @workspace/db run migrate   # Apply migrations
pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push      # Push schema directly (dev only, no migration file)

# API code generation (run after editing lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml)
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen

# Testing (requires both servers already running on port 80)
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test              # All Playwright tests
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test:ui           # Playwright UI mode
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test -- --grep "test name"  # Single test by name
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test -- tests/smoke.spec.ts # Single file
```

## Architecture

### Monorepo Layout

```
artifacts/          # Deployable applications
  api-server/       # Express 5 backend
  show-command-center/  # React 19 + Vite frontend
  mockup-sandbox/   # Component preview tool

lib/                # Shared packages
  db/               # Drizzle ORM schema & migrations (PostgreSQL)
  api-spec/         # OpenAPI spec (source of truth for the API contract)
  api-client-react/ # React Query hooks generated from OpenAPI
  api-zod/          # Zod schemas generated from OpenAPI
```

### Data Flow

```
api-spec/openapi.yaml
    → (orval codegen) →
api-client-react/ (React Query hooks) + api-zod/ (Zod schemas)
    ↑ implemented by ↑
api-server/ (Express routes)
    ↓ uses ↓
db/ (Drizzle ORM + schema → drizzle-zod types)
    ↓ uses ↓
PostgreSQL 16
```

### OpenAPI-First Development

The API contract lives in `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml`. After modifying it, run `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen` to regenerate:
- `lib/api-client-react/src/generated/api.ts` — React Query hooks used in the frontend
- `lib/api-zod/src/generated/` — Zod schemas for request/response validation

### Frontend Pages

| Route | Component | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | Dashboard | Show cards, "Next Up" banner, overdue items |
| `/calendar` | Calendar | Monthly view with color-coded show chips |
| `/shows/:id` | Show Detail | Tabs: Tasks, E-Blasts, Links |
| `/office-tasks` | OfficeTasks | Office-wide task management |

### Backend Routes

All routes are under `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/`: `/shows`, `/shows/:showId/tasks`, `/shows/:showId/eblasts`, `/shows/:showId/links`, `/calendar`, `/dashboard/summary`, `/dashboard/overdue`, `/office-tasks`, `/venues`, `/export`.

The `/export` route returns ICS (iCalendar) format for importing shows into calendar apps.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required by |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | API server + DB migrations |
| `PORT` | Vite frontend dev server |
| `BASE_PATH` | Vite frontend base path |
| `NODE_ENV` | API server |

## Key Conventions

- **Package manager**: pnpm only — a `preinstall` script enforces this.
- **Node version**: 24; **TypeScript**: 5.9.
- **Zod imports**: Use `zod/v4` — all schemas in this repo import from `"zod/v4"`, not `"zod"`.
- **Workspace deps**: Use `workspace:*` to reference local packages.
- **DB types**: Drizzle-zod auto-generates Zod schemas from the DB schema; use these rather than writing them by hand.
- **UI components**: Radix UI primitives + custom wrappers in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/ui/`.
- **Routing**: wouter (not React Router).
- **Logging**: Pino with HTTP middleware on the server.

## Domain Logic

### Urgency System

Show urgency is based on days until `moveInDate` (see `getUrgencyInfo` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`):

| Days remaining | Color | Label |
|---|---|---|
| past | Gray | PAST |
| 0–7 | Red | URGENT |
| 8–13 | Amber | CLOSE |
| 14–30 | Yellow | SOON |
| 31–60 | Green | IN PROGRESS |
| 61+ | Indigo | PLANNING |

### Show Archive Logic

A show is considered **active** if `dismantleDate ?? moveInDate >= today`; otherwise it is **archived**. There is no explicit archived flag in the DB — the dashboard route computes this dynamically.

### DB Schema Key Fields

- **shows**: `moveInDate` (required), `dismantleDate`, `advanceWarehouseDate`, `discountDeadline`, `onlineOrderDeadline`, `showStart`, `venue`, `tags` (text array).
- **tasks**: completion tracked via `completed` boolean + `completedAt` timestamp; has `category`, `dueDate`, `dueDateRule`, `notes`.
- **eblasts**: completion tracked via `sent` boolean + `sentAt` timestamp (not `completed`/`completedAt`); no category field.
- **office_tasks**: has `priority` (`low`/`medium`/`high`) and `status` (`todo`/`in-progress`/`done`) fields in addition to `completed`; standalone (no `showId`).
- **links**: `title` + `url` only; no completion state.
- **venues**: lookup table referenced by `shows.venue` (text, not a foreign key).

### Task Categories

Tasks belong to one of six hardcoded categories (each has a distinct color and a set of preset templates with calculated due dates):

- **Fire Marshal** — deadlines relative to move-in date (calendar and business days)
- **ID Sign** — deadlines relative to move-in date
- **Warehouse Manifest** — deadlines relative to `advanceWarehouseDate`
- **Show Bucket** — deadlines relative to move-in date and `onlineOrderDeadline`
- **Vehicle Spotting** — deadlines relative to move-in date
- **Electrical** — deadlines relative to `onlineOrderDeadline`

The full preset list lives in `task-list.tsx` and `eblast-list.tsx`. Each preset computes a `dueDate` and stores a human-readable `dueDateRule` string (e.g. `"30 biz days before move-in"`) as display text — it is not re-evaluated after creation.

Category badge colors come from `getCategoryColor` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`.

### Date Parsing

Always use `parseDateStr` from `lib/date-utils.ts` to convert `YYYY-MM-DD` strings to `Date` objects. Using `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` directly parses as UTC midnight and shifts the date backward by one day in US timezones.

On the server, `sanitizeDates` in the shows route converts empty-string date fields to `null` before writing to the DB.

# Workspace

## Overview

pnpm workspace monorepo using TypeScript. Each package manages its own dependencies.

## Stack

- **Monorepo tool**: pnpm workspaces
- **Node.js version**: 24
- **Package manager**: pnpm
- **TypeScript version**: 5.9
- **API framework**: Express 5
- **Database**: PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM
- **Validation**: Zod (`zod/v4`), `drizzle-zod`
- **API codegen**: Orval (from OpenAPI spec)
- **Build**: esbuild (CJS bundle)

## Key Commands

- `pnpm run typecheck` — full typecheck across all packages
- `pnpm run build` — typecheck + build all packages
- `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen` — regenerate API hooks and Zod schemas from OpenAPI spec
- `pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push` — push DB schema changes (dev only)
- `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev` — run API server locally

See the `pnpm-workspace` skill for workspace structure, TypeScript setup, and package details.

## Artifacts

### Show Command Center (`artifacts/show-command-center`)
Trade show project management tool for Exhibitor Services teams at General Service Contractors.

**Features:**
- Dashboard with "Next Up" banner, urgency-color-coded show cards, sort controls (Date/Name/Overdue), archived shows section
- Calendar view — monthly with color-coded task/eblast chips, show filter, day detail panel
- Show Detail view — tabs for Tasks, e-Blasts, Links
- Preset task & e-blast templates with calculated due dates (calendar/business days)
- Custom tasks/e-blasts with specific or relative dates
- Dark/light mode (default dark navy)
- No authentication — open shared workspace

**Urgency System:**
- 0–3 days: Red (DUE SOON), 4–7: Amber (URGENT), 8–14: Yellow (SOON), 15–30: Green (ON TRACK), 31+: Indigo (LATER), past: Gray

**DB Schema:** shows, tasks, eblasts, links tables in `lib/db/src/schema/`

**API Routes:** /api/shows, /api/shows/:id/tasks, /api/shows/:id/eblasts, /api/shows/:id/links, /api/calendar, /api/dashboard/summary

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

**Show Command Center** — a trade show project management tool for Exhibitor Services teams at General Service Contractors. Built as a pnpm monorepo with a React frontend, Express backend, and PostgreSQL database.

## Common Commands

```bash
# Build & typecheck
pnpm run build                  # Typecheck + build all packages
pnpm run typecheck              # Full typecheck across all packages

# Development
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev           # Build (esbuild) then start API server (no watch; restart to pick up changes)
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run dev  # Start frontend (Vite HMR)

# Database
pnpm --filter @workspace/db run generate  # Generate new migration
pnpm --filter @workspace/db run migrate   # Apply migrations
pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push      # Push schema directly (dev only, no migration file)

# API code generation (run after editing lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml)
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen

# Testing (requires both servers already running on port 80)
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test              # All Playwright tests
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test:ui           # Playwright UI mode
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test -- --grep "test name"  # Single test by name
pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test -- tests/smoke.spec.ts # Single file
```

## Architecture

### Monorepo Layout

```
artifacts/          # Deployable applications
  api-server/       # Express 5 backend
  show-command-center/  # React 19 + Vite frontend
  mockup-sandbox/   # Component preview tool

lib/                # Shared packages
  db/               # Drizzle ORM schema & migrations (PostgreSQL)
  api-spec/         # OpenAPI spec (source of truth for the API contract)
  api-client-react/ # React Query hooks generated from OpenAPI
  api-zod/          # Zod schemas generated from OpenAPI
```

### Data Flow

```
api-spec/openapi.yaml
    → (orval codegen) →
api-client-react/ (React Query hooks) + api-zod/ (Zod schemas)
    ↑ implemented by ↑
api-server/ (Express routes)
    ↓ uses ↓
db/ (Drizzle ORM + schema → drizzle-zod types)
    ↓ uses ↓
PostgreSQL 16
```

### OpenAPI-First Development

The API contract lives in `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml`. After modifying it, run `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen` to regenerate:
- `lib/api-client-react/src/generated/api.ts` — React Query hooks used in the frontend
- `lib/api-zod/src/generated/` — Zod schemas for request/response validation

### Frontend Pages

| Route | Component | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | Dashboard | Show cards, "Next Up" banner, overdue items |
| `/calendar` | Calendar | Monthly view with color-coded show chips |
| `/shows/:id` | Show Detail | Tabs: Tasks, E-Blasts, Links |
| `/office-tasks` | OfficeTasks | Office-wide task management |

### Backend Routes

All routes are under `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/`: `/shows`, `/shows/:showId/tasks`, `/shows/:showId/eblasts`, `/shows/:showId/links`, `/calendar`, `/dashboard/summary`, `/dashboard/overdue`, `/office-tasks`, `/venues`, `/export`.

The `/export` route returns ICS (iCalendar) format for importing shows into calendar apps.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required by |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | API server + DB migrations |
| `PORT` | Vite frontend dev server |
| `BASE_PATH` | Vite frontend base path |
| `NODE_ENV` | API server |

## Key Conventions

- **Package manager**: pnpm only — a `preinstall` script enforces this.
- **Node version**: 24; **TypeScript**: 5.9.
- **Zod imports**: Use `zod/v4` — all schemas in this repo import from `"zod/v4"`, not `"zod"`.
- **Workspace deps**: Use `workspace:*` to reference local packages.
- **DB types**: Drizzle-zod auto-generates Zod schemas from the DB schema; use these rather than writing them by hand.
- **UI components**: Radix UI primitives + custom wrappers in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/ui/`.
- **Routing**: wouter (not React Router).
- **Logging**: Pino with HTTP middleware on the server.

## Domain Logic

### Urgency System

Show urgency is based on days until `moveInDate` (see `getUrgencyInfo` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`):

| Days remaining | Color | Label |
|---|---|---|
| past | Gray | PAST |
| 0–7 | Red | URGENT |
| 8–13 | Amber | CLOSE |
| 14–30 | Yellow | SOON |
| 31–60 | Green | IN PROGRESS |
| 61+ | Indigo | PLANNING |

### Show Archive Logic

A show is considered **active** if `dismantleDate ?? moveInDate >= today`; otherwise it is **archived**. There is no explicit archived flag in the DB — the dashboard route computes this dynamically.

### DB Schema Key Fields

- **shows**: `moveInDate` (required), `dismantleDate`, `advanceWarehouseDate`, `discountDeadline`, `onlineOrderDeadline`, `showStart`, `venue`, `tags` (text array).
- **tasks**: completion tracked via `completed` boolean + `completedAt` timestamp; has `category`, `dueDate`, `dueDateRule`, `notes`.
- **eblasts**: completion tracked via `sent` boolean + `sentAt` timestamp (not `completed`/`completedAt`); no category field.
- **office_tasks**: has `priority` (`low`/`medium`/`high`) and `status` (`todo`/`in-progress`/`done`) fields in addition to `completed`; standalone (no `showId`).
- **links**: `title` + `url` only; no completion state.
- **venues**: lookup table referenced by `shows.venue` (text, not a foreign key).

### Task Categories

Tasks belong to one of six hardcoded categories (each has a distinct color and a set of preset templates with calculated due dates):

- **Fire Marshal** — deadlines relative to move-in date (calendar and business days)
- **ID Sign** — deadlines relative to move-in date
- **Warehouse Manifest** — deadlines relative to `advanceWarehouseDate`
- **Show Bucket** — deadlines relative to move-in date and `onlineOrderDeadline`
- **Vehicle Spotting** — deadlines relative to move-in date
- **Electrical** — deadlines relative to `onlineOrderDeadline`

The full preset list lives in `task-list.tsx` and `eblast-list.tsx`. Each preset computes a `dueDate` and stores a human-readable `dueDateRule` string (e.g. `"30 biz days before move-in"`) as display text — it is not re-evaluated after creation.

Category badge colors come from `getCategoryColor` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`.

### Date Parsing

Always use `parseDateStr` from `lib/date-utils.ts` to convert `YYYY-MM-DD` strings to `Date` objects. Using `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` directly parses as UTC midnight and shifts the date backward by one day in US timezones.

**Show Command Center** — a trade show project management tool for Exhibitor Services teams at General Service Contractors. Built as a pnpm monorepo with a React frontend, Express backend, and PostgreSQL database.

```bash
# Build & typecheck
pnpm run build                  # Typecheck + build all packages

# Development

## Architecture

### Monorepo Layout

```
artifacts/          # Deployable applications
  api-server/       # Express 5 backend
  show-command-center/  # React 19 + Vite frontend
  mockup-sandbox/   # Component preview tool

lib/                # Shared packages
  db/               # Drizzle ORM schema & migrations (PostgreSQL)

  api-client-react/ # React Query hooks generated from OpenAPI
  api-zod/          # Zod schemas generated from OpenAPI
```

### Data Flow

```
api-spec/openapi.yaml
    → (orval codegen) →
api-client-react/ (React Query hooks) + api-zod/ (Zod schemas)
    ↑ implemented by ↑
api-server/ (Express routes)
    ↓ uses ↓
db/ (Drizzle ORM + schema → drizzle-zod types)
    ↓ uses ↓
PostgreSQL 16
```

### OpenAPI-First Development

The API contract lives in `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml`. After modifying it, run `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen` to regenerate:
- `lib/api-client-react/src/generated/api.ts` — React Query hooks used in the frontend
- `lib/api-zod/src/generated/` — Zod schemas for request/response validation

### Frontend Pages

| Route | Component | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | Dashboard | Show cards, "Next Up" banner, overdue items |
| `/calendar` | Calendar | Monthly view with color-coded show chips |
| `/shows/:id` | Show Detail | Tabs: Tasks, E-Blasts, Links |
| `/office-tasks` | OfficeTasks | Office-wide task management |

### Backend Routes

All routes are under `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/`: `/shows`, `/shows/:showId/tasks`, `/shows/:showId/eblasts`, `/shows/:showId/links`, `/calendar`, `/dashboard/summary`, `/dashboard/overdue`, `/office-tasks`, `/venues`, `/export`.

The `/export` route returns ICS (iCalendar) format for importing shows into calendar apps.

| Variable | Required by |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | API server + DB migrations |
| `PORT` | API server + Vite frontend dev server |
| `BASE_PATH` | Vite frontend base path |
| `NODE_ENV` | API server |

## Key Conventions

- **Package manager**: pnpm only — a `preinstall` script enforces this.
- **Node version**: 24; **TypeScript**: 5.9.
- **Zod imports**: Use `zod/v4` — all schemas in this repo import from `"zod/v4"`, not `"zod"`.
- **Workspace deps**: Use `workspace:*` to reference local packages.
- **DB types**: Drizzle-zod auto-generates Zod schemas from the DB schema; use these rather than writing them by hand.
- **UI components**: Radix UI primitives + custom wrappers in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/ui/`.
- **Routing**: wouter (not React Router).
- **Logging**: Pino with HTTP middleware on the server.

## Domain Logic

### Urgency System

Show urgency is based on days until `moveInDate` (see `getUrgencyInfo` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`):

| Days remaining | Color | Label |
|---|---|---|
| past | Gray | PAST |
| 0–7 | Red | URGENT |
| 8–13 | Amber | CLOSE |
| 14–30 | Yellow | SOON |
| 31–60 | Green | IN PROGRESS |
| 61+ | Indigo | PLANNING |

### Show Archive Logic

A show is considered **active** if `dismantleDate ?? moveInDate >= today`; otherwise it is **archived**. There is no explicit archived flag in the DB — the dashboard route computes this dynamically.

### DB Schema Key Fields

- **shows**: `moveInDate` (required), `dismantleDate`, `advanceWarehouseDate`, `discountDeadline`, `onlineOrderDeadline`, `showStart`, `venue`, `tags` (text array).
- **tasks**: completion tracked via `completed` boolean + `completedAt` timestamp; has `category`, `dueDate`, `dueDateRule`, `notes`.
- **eblasts**: completion tracked via `sent` boolean + `sentAt` timestamp (not `completed`/`completedAt`); no category field.
- **office_tasks**: has `priority` (`low`/`medium`/`high`) and `status` (`todo`/`in-progress`/`done`) fields in addition to `completed`; standalone (no `showId`).
- **links**: `title` + `url` only; no completion state.
- **venues**: lookup table referenced by `shows.venue` (text, not a foreign key).

### Task Categories

Tasks belong to one of six hardcoded categories (each has a distinct color and a set of preset templates with calculated due dates):

- **Fire Marshal** — deadlines relative to move-in date (calendar and business days)
- **ID Sign** — deadlines relative to move-in date
- **Warehouse Manifest** — deadlines relative to `advanceWarehouseDate`
- **Show Bucket** — deadlines relative to move-in date and `onlineOrderDeadline`
- **Vehicle Spotting** — deadlines relative to move-in date
- **Electrical** — deadlines relative to `onlineOrderDeadline`

The full preset list lives in `task-list.tsx` and `eblast-list.tsx`. Each preset computes a `dueDate` and stores a human-readable `dueDateRule` string (e.g. `"30 biz days before move-in"`) as display text — it is not re-evaluated after creation.

Category badge colors come from `getCategoryColor` in `artifacts/show-command-center/src/lib/date-utils.ts`.

### Date Parsing

Always use `parseDateStr` from `lib/date-utils.ts` to convert `YYYY-MM-DD` strings to `Date` objects. Using `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` directly parses as UTC midnight and shifts the date backward by one day in US timezones.

On the server, `sanitizeDates` in the shows route converts empty-string date fields to `null` before writing to the DB.

#1 - Task Filter, Sort & Group in Show Detail
What & Why
The task list in Show Detail grows long for busy shows. Users need to quickly focus on specific categories (e.g., only Fire Marshal tasks), reorder by different criteria, and optionally view tasks grouped by category rather than by urgency status. All changes are purely frontend — no API changes needed.

Done looks like
A compact toolbar sits between the "Tasks" heading and the task list with three controls: Filter, Sort, and Group
Filter: a dropdown multi-select for category ("All", "Show Bucket", "Fire Marshal", "ID Sign", "Warehouse Manifest", "Vehicle Spotting", "Electrical"). Active filters show as dismissible chips next to the dropdown. Filtering applies across all groups.
Sort: a dropdown with options — Due Date (default, ascending), Due Date (descending), Name A→Z, Category
Group by: a toggle/dropdown with two modes:
Status (default): current behavior — Overdue / Upcoming / Completed sections
Category: one collapsible section per category (alphabetical), tasks within each sorted by the active sort. An "Uncategorized" section catches tasks with no category.
Completed tasks collapsible section still appears at the bottom in Status grouping; in Category grouping, completed tasks are visually dimmed within their category section rather than separated
Toolbar state is local (not persisted) — resets on page navigation
Controls are compact and unobtrusive; toolbar disappears gracefully if there are no tasks
Out of scope
Persisting filter/sort/group preferences to localStorage or the server
Filtering by date range
Searching tasks by name (separate feature)
Any changes to the e-blasts tab
Steps
Add toolbar UI — Add a row of controls (Filter, Sort, Group) above the task list. Use existing shadcn Select and Badge components; no new dependencies. Keep it visually compact.
Wire filter logic — Apply the active category filter to the task array before grouping, hiding tasks whose category doesn't match any selected filter. "All" clears the filter.
Wire sort logic — Apply the selected sort to each section's task array within the existing useMemo grouping. Due Date ascending is the default (preserving current behavior).
Implement Category grouping mode — When Group = Category, replace the overdue/upcoming/completed sections with one collapsible section per category. Within each section, completed tasks are dimmed in-place. Sections start expanded.

Clean. The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**Toolbar** (appears between the Tasks heading and task list, hidden when there are no tasks):
- **Filter** — popover with per-category checkboxes; active selections shown as dismissible `×` chips inline. "Clear all" button appears in the popover when filters are active.
- **Sort** — dropdown: Due Date ↑ (default, preserves existing behavior), Due Date ↓, Name A→Z, Category.
- **Group** — segmented Status/Category toggle.

**Status mode** (default): existing Overdue/Upcoming/Completed sections, now sorted by the active sort. Empty state message adapts when a filter is active.

**Category mode**: one collapsible section per category (in the canonical order from `PRESET_CATEGORIES`), plus an Uncategorized catch-all at the end. Sections start expanded, collapse independently. Completed tasks stay in their category section and are automatically dimmed (the existing `opacity-60` on `TaskRow` handles this). No separate completed section.

All state is local — resets on page navigation.

## Approved Plan:
# Plan: Functional Search Bar

## Context

The navbar search bar (`layout.tsx`) is a static, non-functional `<Input>` with no state, no event handlers, and no connection to the dashboard. Users see a "Search shows..." field that does nothing. This plan wires it up to filter shows on the dashboard — the only view that lists shows — with real-time filtering when already on the dashboard and Enter-key navigation from other pages.

## Approach: URL query param (`?q=`)

State lives in the URL (`/?q=imex`). No context or prop drilling needed.

- **Layout** owns the input, syncs its value to/from the URL `?q` param, and navigates on change (replace-mode when already on `/`, push-mode on Enter from other pages).
- **Dashboard** reads `?q` from the URL and filters the shows list before rendering.
- **wouter** is already imported in both files; `useSearch()` is the only new hook needed.

---

## File Changes

### 1. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/layout.tsx`

**Imports to add:** `useState, useEffect` (react); `useSearch` (wouter); `X` (lucide-react)

**Logic to add:**
```
const [, navigate] = useLocation();          // already have [location]
const searchStr = useSearch();               // "?q=imex" or ""

// Sync input value from URL when on dashboard
const qFromUrl = location === "/" ? (new URLSearchParams(searchStr).get("q") ?? "") : "";
const [query, setQuery] = useState(qFromUrl);
useEffect(() => { setQuery(qFromUrl); }, [qFromUrl]);

const handleChange = (val: string) => {
  setQuery(val);
  if (location === "/") {
    // Real-time filtering on dashboard (replace so Back button isn't polluted)
    navigate(val.trim() ? `/?q=${encodeURIComponent(val.trim())}` : "/", { replace: true });
  }
};

const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Enter" && query.trim()) navigate(`/?q=${encodeURIComponent(query.trim())}`);
  if (e.key === "Enter" && !query.trim()) navigate("/");
  if (e.key === "Escape") { setQuery(""); navigate("/"); }
};

const clearSearch = () => { setQuery(""); navigate("/"); };
```

**JSX changes:**
- Make `<Input>` controlled: add `value={query}`, `onChange`, `onKeyDown`
- Add `pr-8` to Input className (room for X button)
- Render `<button onClick={clearSearch}><X /></button>` absolutely positioned on the right when `query` is non-empty

---

### 2. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/pages/dashboard.tsx`

**Imports to add:** `useSearch` (wouter)

**Logic to add:**
```tsx
const searchStr = useSearch();
const searchQuery = new URLSearchParams(searchStr).get("q")?.trim() ?? "";
```

**`activeShows` useMemo** — add one filter step after the existing date filter:
```tsx
.filter(s => !searchQuery ||
  s.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
  (s.venue ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()))
```

Apply the same filter to **`archivedShows`** useMemo.

**Empty state** — update the "No active shows" message:
```tsx
{searchQuery
  ? `No shows match "${searchQuery}".`
  : "No active shows found. Add one to get started."}
```

**Auto-expand archived** — if `searchQuery` is set and `archivedShows.length > 0`, default `archivedOpen` to `true`:
```tsx
const [archivedOpen, setArchivedOpen] = useState(false);
// Add this effect:
useEffect(() => {
  if (searchQuery && archivedShows.length > 0) setArchivedOpen(true);
}, [searchQuery, archivedShows.length]);
```

---

|---|---|
| Type on dashboard | Shows filter in real-time; URL updates (replace) |
| Press Enter on dashboard | Same as above but adds to history |
| Type + Enter from Calendar/Office Tasks | Navigates to `/?q=term` |
| Press Escape anywhere | Clears input, navigates to `/` |
| Click × button | Clears input, navigates to `/` |
| Navigate to `/?q=foo` directly | Input populates with "foo", shows filtered |
| No matches in active, matches in archived | Archived section auto-expands |

No API, schema, or backend changes needed.

message.content: Would it be possible to give me the power to adjust the pre-set tasks in the app without too much complication?

lastPrompt: Would it be possible to give me the power to adjust the pre-set tasks in the app without too much complication?

content.text:
Yes, it's doable and the scope is manageable. Here's the tradeoff to consider:

**The core challenge** — presets today are pure code: each entry hard-calculates a date (e.g. `subBusinessDays(mi, 30)`). To make them editable from the UI, the calculation logic needs to become *data* — something like `{ offset: 30, unit: "biz", direction: "before", anchor: "moveInDate" }` — so the app can interpret it at runtime.

**Recommended approach** — a `/settings/presets` admin page:
- New `preset_tasks` table in the DB (category, name, offset, unit `cal|biz`, anchor `moveInDate|advanceWarehouseDate|onlineOrderDeadline`, direction `before|after`)
- A small API route (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/preset-tasks`)
- A settings page with a simple table — edit rows inline, add/delete, drag to reorder within category
- The `AddTaskDialog` reads from the API instead of the hardcoded array

The anchors map to exactly the 3 date fields presets already use. The "Manual entry" preset (Show Bucket → Bucket Due Date) would stay as a special-case flag.

**What you'd give up** — presets that depend on *two* anchors in one formula (there aren't any currently, but it closes that door). All 17 current presets fit the `offset + unit + anchor` pattern cleanly.

**Rough scope** — DB migration, 1 API route, 1 page, update `AddTaskDialog`. Medium-sized task, nothing exotic.

Want me to plan it out?

content: Working on Show Command Center, a trade show management app. Just proposed making preset tasks editable via a settings page backed by the database — waiting for approval to start planning.

message.content: Yes, but before that, where do we put it? I'm thinking a standalone page. Next to Office Tasks, like maybe Settings.

content.text:
A `/settings` page in the nav next to Office Tasks is exactly right — good call making it standalone rather than burying it in a modal or existing page.

One small thing to decide: the nav label. **"Settings"** is better than "Presets" since the page could naturally absorb other config in the future (default sort, notification preferences, etc.) without a rename. The route `/settings` with a "Preset Tasks" heading inside keeps it specific now but open later.

Want me to go ahead and plan the full implementation?

message.content: Yep lets do all of it.

Perfect! Now I have all the information needed. Let me compile the comprehensive summary:

## Summary: Preset Tasks Feature Design Patterns

### 1. **Drizzle ORM Column Patterns** (`/home/runner/workspace/lib/db/src/schema/`)

From the schema files, here are the exact patterns:

**Text with default value:**
```typescript
priority: text("priority").notNull().default("medium"),
status: text("status").notNull().default("todo"),
```

**Text nullable (no default):**
```typescript
notes: text("notes"),
category: text("category"),
```

**Integer:**
```typescript
id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
showId: integer("show_id").notNull().references(() => showsTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
```

**Boolean:**
```typescript
completed: boolean("completed").notNull().default(false),
```

**Date:**
```typescript
dueDate: date("due_date"),
```

**Timestamp with timezone:**
```typescript
createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
completedAt: timestamp("completed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
```

**Array:**
```typescript
tags: text("tags").array().notNull().default(sql`'{}'`),
```

### 2. **pgTable Call Pattern**

```typescript
export const tableName = pgTable("table_name", {
  // columns
});
```

### 3. **Drizzle-Zod Schema Generation**

```typescript
export const insertOfficeTaskSchema = createInsertSchema(officeTasksTable).omit({ id: true, createdAt: true });
export type InsertOfficeTask = z.infer<typeof insertOfficeTaskSchema>;
export type OfficeTask = typeof officeTasksTable.$inferSelect;
```

The pattern:
- `createInsertSchema()` wraps the table
- `.omit()` removes auto-generated columns (id, createdAt)
- Type inference pulls from zod schema (InsertOfficeTask) and Drizzle (OfficeTask)

### 4. **Full Shape of Preset Entry**

From `/home/runner/workspace/artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/task-list.tsx` (lines 704-733):

```typescript
type PresetEntry = {
  cat: string;              // category name: "Fire Marshal", "ID Sign", etc.
  name: string;             // task name
  requires: unknown;        // condition (date field like show.moveInDate, or boolean true)
  date: string;             // YYYY-MM-DD format (calculated or empty string)
  rule: string;             // human-readable rule description
}
```

**Example entries:**
```typescript
{ cat: "Fire Marshal", name: "Initial Contact Account Executive", requires: show.moveInDate, date: format(subDays(mi, 60), "yyyy-MM-dd"), rule: "60 cal days before move-in" },
{ cat: "Show Bucket", name: "Bucket Due Date", requires: true, date: "", rule: "Manual entry — set due date after adding" },
```

### 5. **officeTasks Router CRUD Patterns** (`/home/runner/workspace/artifacts/api-server/src/routes/officeTasks.ts`)

**GET /office-tasks:**
- Accepts optional query params: `status`, `priority`, `category`
- Validates with `ListOfficeTasksQueryParams.safeParse(req.query)`
- Builds dynamic `where` conditions using `eq()` and `and()`
- Returns array of OfficeTask objects
- No pagination

**POST /office-tasks:**
- Validates body with `CreateOfficeTaskBody.safeParse()`
- Converts empty strings to null (`dueDate === "" → null`, etc.)
- Syncs `status="completed"` with `completed=true` and sets `completedAt=new Date()`
- Applies defaults: `priority ?? "medium"`, `status ?? "todo"`
- Returns single created task (201)

**PUT /office-tasks/:taskId:**
- Validates params with `UpdateOfficeTaskParams.safeParse({ taskId: Number(req.params.taskId) })`
- Fetches existing to check 404
- Converts empty strings to null
- **Complex sync logic**: `completed` ↔ `status` consistency:
  - If `completed=true`: set `completedAt` and `status="completed"`
  - If `completed=false`: clear `completedAt` and revert status
  - If `status="completed"`: set `completed=true`
  - If `status` is non-completed: set `completed=false` and clear `completedAt`
- Returns updated task (200)

**DELETE /office-tasks/:taskId:**
- Validates params with `UpdateOfficeTaskParams`
- Fetches to check 404
- Deletes and returns 204 (no content)

### 6. **OpenAPI Spec Patterns** (`/home/runner/workspace/lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` lines 474-557)

**Path structure:**
```yaml
/office-tasks:
  get:
    operationId: listOfficeTasks
    tags: [officetasks]
    parameters:
      - name: status
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
    responses:
      "200":
        description: List of office tasks
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/OfficeTask"

  post:
    operationId: createOfficeTask
    requestBody:
      required: true
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateOfficeTaskBody"
    responses:
      "201":
        description: Created office task
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/OfficeTask"
```

**Response schemas use `$ref`** (lines 503, 513, 520, 545) to reference component schemas defined at line 1026+.

**Component schema (inline properties, not enum):**
```yaml
OfficeTask:
  type: object
  required: [id, title, priority, status, completed, createdAt]
  properties:
    id:
      type: integer
    title:
      type: string
    priority:
      type: string  # No enum constraint
    status:
      type: string  # No enum constraint
    category:
      type: string
      nullable: true
    completed:
      type: boolean
    completedAt:
      type: string
      format: date-time
      nullable: true
```

---

## Key Patterns for Preset Tasks Implementation

1. **Database table**: Use same pattern as `officeTasksTable` — no showId (standalone), text columns with defaults for enums
2. **Schema generation**: Use `createInsertSchema().omit({ id: true, createdAt: true })`
3. **API validation**: Create Zod schemas in `api-zod` (auto-generated from OpenAPI), validate with `.safeParse()`
4. **Router handlers**: Follow officeTasks pattern—convert empty strings to null, handle 404s, use `db.select().from().where()`
5. **OpenAPI**: Define paths with operationId, use `$ref` for requestBody/response schemas, define schemas in components section
6. **Preset shape**: `{ name, category, order, description, dueDateRule?, icon?, color? }` (infer additional fields from use case)

message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - **Task 1**: Improve the existing CLAUDE.md with accurate codebase documentation (PORT env var fix, auto-migration note, preset template file paths).
   - **Task 2**: Implement a Filter/Sort/Group toolbar for the task list in Show Detail — Filter by category (chips), Sort by due date/name/category, and toggle between Status grouping (existing) and Category grouping (collapsible per-category sections).
   - **Task 3**: Create a Playwright test for the Filter/Sort/Group toolbar feature.
   - **Task 4**: Wire up the existing (non-functional) navbar search bar to filter shows on the dashboard using URL query params (`?q=`). Real-time filtering on dashboard, Enter-key navigation from other pages.
   - **Task 4b**: Fix a bug where two × buttons appeared in the search input (one native from `type="search"`, one custom).
   - **Task 5 (in progress)**: Plan and implement a `/settings` page with a "Preset Tasks" CRUD admin UI so the user can add/edit/delete preset task templates without touching code. Standalone page in the nav next to Office Tasks, labeled "Settings".

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Monorepo**: pnpm workspaces with `artifacts/` (apps) and `lib/` (shared packages)
   - **OpenAPI-first**: `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` → orval codegen → `lib/api-client-react` (React Query hooks) + `lib/api-zod` (Zod schemas)
   - **Drizzle ORM** + PostgreSQL; drizzle-zod generates Zod schemas from DB schema
   - **wouter** routing (not React Router); `useLocation`, `useSearch` hooks
   - **URL query params** for search state (`?q=term`) — no context/prop-drilling needed
   - **Playwright** tests with `workers: 1`, real database, `baseURL: http://localhost:80`
   - **Radix UI** primitives + shadcn components; Popover renders in portals
   - **Zod** imports from `"zod/v4"` (not `"zod"`)
   - **Tailwind CSS** utility classes used as DOM selectors in Playwright tests
   - `parseDateStr` from `lib/date-utils.ts` for YYYY-MM-DD parsing (avoids UTC offset issues)
   - `subBusinessDays`, `addBusinessDays`, `subDays`, `addDays` from date-fns for preset date calculations
   - PRESET_CATEGORIES: `["Fire Marshal", "ID Sign", "Warehouse Manifest", "Show Bucket", "Vehicle Spotting", "Electrical"]`
   - **Structured due date rule**: offset (int) + unit (cal/biz) + direction (before/after) + anchor (moveInDate/advanceWarehouseDate/onlineOrderDeadline)

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`CLAUDE.md`** (modified)
     - Fixed PORT env var row: now shows "API server + Vite frontend dev server"
     - Added note: API server runs DB migrations on startup (skips if `shows` table exists)
     - Updated preset template paths to full paths: `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/task-list.tsx` and `eblast-list.tsx`

   - **`artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/task-list.tsx`** (heavily modified)
     - Added `Filter, X` to lucide imports
     - Added `SortMode` type and `applySortToTasks()` helper before `TaskList`
     - Added `data-testid="task-toolbar"` to toolbar wrapper div
     - Full new `TaskList` state: `filterCategories`, `sortMode`, `groupMode`, `filterOpen`, `completedOpen`, `catSectionOpen`
     - `filteredTasks` useMemo (applies category filter to raw tasks)
     - Updated `groupedTasks` useMemo (uses filteredTasks + applySortToTasks)
     - New `categoryGrouped` useMemo (groups by PRESET_CATEGORIES order, Uncategorized catch-all)
     - Toolbar JSX: Filter popover (`.cursor-pointer.select-none` items), dismissible chips, Sort Select, Status/Category toggle buttons
     - Category grouping render: Collapsible per category, `catSectionOpen[cat] ?? true`, collapse button, `getCategoryColor(cat).split(" ").find(c => c.startsWith("text-"))` for header color
     - Status grouping render: unchanged overdue/upcoming/completed sections but now sorted

   - **`artifacts/show-command-center/tests/task-filter-sort-group.spec.ts`** (created)
     - 14 tests in `test.describe("Task toolbar — Filter / Sort / Group")`
     - `beforeEach`: navigate to first show
     - `addTaskWithCategory()` helper creates tasks via custom tab
     - Uses `data-testid="task-toolbar"` for scoping
     - Filter popover items located by `.cursor-pointer.select-none` (unique to popover rows)
     - Group toggle active state checked via `toHaveClass(/bg-primary/)`
     - Category sections located by `.font-semibold.uppercase.tracking-wider`

   - **`artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/layout.tsx`** (modified)
     - Added `useState, useEffect` from react; `useSearch` from wouter; `X` from lucide-react
     - `const [location, navigate] = useLocation()` (destructures navigate too)
     - `const searchStr = useSearch()`
     - `qFromUrl`: reads `?q=` param, only when `location === "/"`
     - `query` state synced via `useEffect(() => { setQuery(qFromUrl); }, [qFromUrl])`
     - `handleChange`: updates state; on dashboard, calls `navigate(..., { replace: true })`
     - `handleKeyDown`: Enter → `navigate("/?q=term")`, Escape → `setQuery(""); navigate("/")`
     - `clearSearch`: `setQuery(""); navigate("/")`
     - Input: `type="text"` (NOT `type="search"`), controlled with `value={query}`, `onChange`, `onKeyDown`, `className="w-64 pl-8 pr-8 h-9 ..."`

# Plan: Preset Tasks Settings Page

## Goal

Add a `/settings` page with a CRUD admin UI so the user can add, edit, and delete preset task templates without touching code. The existing hardcoded presets in `task-list.tsx` are migrated to a `preset_tasks` DB table; `AddTaskDialog` fetches from the API instead of the static array.

---

## Files to Create / Modify

### 1. `lib/db/src/schema/presetTasks.ts` (new)

```ts
import { pgTable, text, serial, timestamp, integer, boolean } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { createInsertSchema } from "drizzle-zod";
import { z } from "zod/v4";

export const presetTasksTable = pgTable("preset_tasks", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  name: text("name").notNull(),
  category: text("category").notNull(),
  dueDateOffset: integer("due_date_offset"),    // null = manual entry
  dueDateUnit: text("due_date_unit"),           // "cal" | "biz" | null
  dueDateDirection: text("due_date_direction"), // "before" | "after" | null
  dueDateAnchor: text("due_date_anchor"),       // "moveInDate" | "advanceWarehouseDate" | "onlineOrderDeadline" | null
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
});

export const insertPresetTaskSchema = createInsertSchema(presetTasksTable).omit({ id: true, createdAt: true });
export type InsertPresetTask = z.infer<typeof insertPresetTaskSchema>;
export type PresetTask = typeof presetTasksTable.$inferSelect;
```

### 2. `lib/db/src/schema/index.ts` (modify)
Add `export * from "./presetTasks";`

### 3. `lib/db/migrations/0001_preset_tasks.sql` (new)
SQL migration that:
- Creates the `preset_tasks` table
- Seeds all 17 presets from the current hardcoded list (exact offsets below)

Seed rows:

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Initial Contact Account Executive | Fire Marshal | 60 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Check In / Submit | Fire Marshal | 30 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Hard Deadline | Fire Marshal | 30 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Contact Client / Give Deadline | ID Sign | 30 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| ID Sign Deadline | ID Sign | 12 | biz | before | moveInDate |

| Contact Declared but Not Received | Warehouse Manifest | 3 | biz | before | advanceWarehouseDate |
| Get Bucket Due Dates & Quantities | Show Bucket | 10 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Create Carpet Plan | Show Bucket | 1 | cal | after | onlineOrderDeadline |

| Bucket Due Date | Show Bucket | NULL | NULL | NULL | NULL |
| Send e-Blast for A.E. Vehicle Spotting | Vehicle Spotting | 60 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Check Vehicle Spotting / Provide To Beau | Vehicle Spotting | 40 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Check Vehicle Spotting / Provide To Beau 2 | Vehicle Spotting | 30 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Contact Electrical Provider | Electrical | 1 | cal | after | onlineOrderDeadline |

### 4. `lib/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json` (modify)
Add entry for `0001_preset_tasks`.

### 5. `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` (modify)
Add paths and schemas for preset tasks CRUD:

**Paths to add** (after `/office-tasks/{taskId}` block):
```yaml
/preset-tasks:
  get:
    operationId: listPresetTasks
    tags: [presettasks]
    summary: List all preset tasks
    responses:
      "200":
        content: array of PresetTask
  post:
    operationId: createPresetTask
    tags: [presettasks]
    requestBody: CreatePresetTaskBody
    responses:
      "201": PresetTask

/preset-tasks/{presetId}:
  put:
    operationId: updatePresetTask
    tags: [presettasks]
    responses:
      "200": PresetTask | "404"
  delete:
    operationId: deletePresetTask
    tags: [presettasks]
    responses:
      "204" | "404"
```

**Schemas to add:**
- `PresetTask`: id, name, category, dueDateOffset (nullable int), dueDateUnit (nullable string), dueDateDirection (nullable string), dueDateAnchor (nullable string), createdAt
- `CreatePresetTaskBody`: name (required), category (required), dueDateOffset, dueDateUnit, dueDateDirection, dueDateAnchor (all optional/nullable)
- `UpdatePresetTaskBody`: all optional

### 6. Run codegen
```bash
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen
```

### 7. `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/presetTasks.ts` (new)
Express CRUD router following the same pattern as `officeTasks.ts`:
- `GET /` → `db.select().from(presetTasksTable)`
- `POST /` → insert with validation
- `PUT /:presetId` → update with 404 check
- `DELETE /:presetId` → delete with 404 check

Import `presetTasksTable` from `@workspace/db`.

### 8. `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts` (modify)
Add: `router.use("/preset-tasks", presetTasksRouter);`

### 9. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/pages/settings.tsx` (new)
Settings page at `/settings`. Layout:
- Title "Settings"
- Subtitle "Manage preset task templates"
- Per-category collapsible sections (same 6 categories)
- Each preset row: name + due date rule label (computed from structured fields) + Edit + Delete buttons
- "Add Preset" button per category → inline form (or small dialog) for name + offset + unit + direction + anchor

The due date rule label is derived from structured fields, e.g.:
- offset=30, unit=biz, direction=before, anchor=moveInDate → "30 biz days before move-in"
- null offset → "Manual entry"

Anchor display names: `moveInDate`→"move-in", `advanceWarehouseDate`→"Advance Warehouse", `onlineOrderDeadline`→"Online Order Deadline"

### 10. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/layout.tsx` (modify)
Add nav link `<Link href="/settings">Settings</Link>` after the Office Tasks link. Use `Settings` icon from lucide-react.

### 11. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/App.tsx` (modify)
Add `import Settings from "@/pages/settings";` and `<Route path="/settings" component={Settings} />`.

### 12. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/task-list.tsx` (modify)
In `AddTaskDialog`:
- Add `useListPresetTasks` hook call
- Replace the hardcoded `presets` array with a `computePresetDate(preset, show)` function that maps structured fields to actual dates using the same `subDays`/`addDays`/`subBusinessDays`/`addBusinessDays` logic
- The preset list still renders identically (category headers, checkboxes, rule text) but data comes from API
- Show a loading skeleton or spinner while fetching; gracefully handle empty state (no presets = show "No presets configured. Add some in Settings.")

The `computePresetDate` helper:
```ts
function computePresetDate(preset: PresetTask, show: Show): { date: string; requires: unknown } {
  if (!preset.dueDateOffset || !preset.dueDateUnit || !preset.dueDateDirection || !preset.dueDateAnchor) {
    return { date: "", requires: true }; // manual
  }
  const anchor = show[preset.dueDateAnchor as keyof Show];
  if (!anchor) return { date: "", requires: null }; // anchor date not set on show
  const anchorDate = parseDateStr(anchor as string);
  let d: Date;
  if (preset.dueDateDirection === "before") {
    d = preset.dueDateUnit === "biz" ? subBusinessDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset) : subDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset);
  } else {
    d = preset.dueDateUnit === "biz" ? addBusinessDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset) : addDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset);
  }
  return { date: format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd"), requires: anchor };
}
```

The `dueDateRule` string displayed and stored on the task is generated from structured fields:
```ts
function ruleLabel(preset: PresetTask): string {
  if (!preset.dueDateOffset) return "Manual entry — set due date after adding";
  const anchor = { moveInDate: "move-in", advanceWarehouseDate: "Advance Warehouse", onlineOrderDeadline: "Online Order Deadline" }[preset.dueDateAnchor!] ?? preset.dueDateAnchor;
  return `${preset.dueDateOffset} ${preset.dueDateUnit} days ${preset.dueDateDirection} ${anchor}`;
}
```

---

## Migration approach

Instead of `pnpm --filter @workspace/db run generate` (which requires a live DB), write the migration SQL file manually to match the Drizzle format (same style as `0000_strong_violations.sql`), and update `_journal.json` manually.

1	# Plan: Functional Search Bar
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	The navbar search bar (`layout.tsx`) is a static, non-functional `<Input>` with no state, no event handlers, and no connection to the dashboard. Users see a "Search shows..." field that does nothing. This plan wires it up to filter shows on the dashboard — the only view that lists shows — with real-time filtering when already on the dashboard and Enter-key navigation from other pages.
6	
7	## Approach: URL query param (`?q=`)
8	
9	State lives in the URL (`/?q=imex`). No context or prop drilling needed.
10	
11	- **Layout** owns the input, syncs its value to/from the URL `?q` param, and navigates on change (replace-mode when already on `/`, push-mode on Enter from other pages).
12	- **Dashboard** reads `?q` from the URL and filters the shows list before rendering.
13	- **wouter** is already imported in both files; `useSearch()` is the only new hook needed.
14	
15	---
16	
17	## File Changes
18	
19	### 1. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/layout.tsx`
20	
21	**Imports to add:** `useState, useEffect` (react); `useSearch` (wouter); `X` (lucide-react)
22	
23	**Logic to add:**
24	```
25	const [, navigate] = useLocation();          // already have [location]
26	const searchStr = useSearch();               // "?q=imex" or ""
27	
28	// Sync input value from URL when on dashboard
29	const qFromUrl = location === "/" ? (new URLSearchParams(searchStr).get("q") ?? "") : "";
30	const [query, setQuery] = useState(qFromUrl);
31	useEffect(() => { setQuery(qFromUrl); }, [qFromUrl]);
32	
33	const handleChange = (val: string) => {
34	  setQuery(val);
35	  if (location === "/") {
36	    // Real-time filtering on dashboard (replace so Back button isn't polluted)
37	    navigate(val.trim() ? `/?q=${encodeURIComponent(val.trim())}` : "/", { replace: true });
38	  }
39	};
40	
41	const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
42	  if (e.key === "Enter" && query.trim()) navigate(`/?q=${encodeURIComponent(query.trim())}`);
43	  if (e.key === "Enter" && !query.trim()) navigate("/");
44	  if (e.key === "Escape") { setQuery(""); navigate("/"); }
45	};
46	
47	const clearSearch = () => { setQuery(""); navigate("/"); };
48	```
49	
50	**JSX changes:**
51	- Make `<Input>` controlled: add `value={query}`, `onChange`, `onKeyDown`
52	- Add `pr-8` to Input className (room for X button)
53	- Render `<button onClick={clearSearch}><X /></button>` absolutely positioned on the right when `query` is non-empty
54	
55	---
56	
57	### 2. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/pages/dashboard.tsx`
58	
59	**Imports to add:** `useSearch` (wouter)
60	
61	**Logic to add:**
62	```tsx
63	const searchStr = useSearch();
64	const searchQuery = new URLSearchParams(searchStr).get("q")?.trim() ?? "";
65	```
66	
67	**`activeShows` useMemo** — add one filter step after the existing date filter:
68	```tsx
69	.filter(s => !searchQuery ||
70	  s.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
71	  (s.venue ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()))
72	```
73	
74	Apply the same filter to **`archivedShows`** useMemo.
75	
76	**Empty state** — update the "No active shows" message:
77	```tsx
78	{searchQuery
79	  ? `No shows match "${searchQuery}".`
80	  : "No active shows found. Add one to get started."}
81	```
82	
83	**Auto-expand archived** — if `searchQuery` is set and `archivedShows.length > 0`, default `archivedOpen` to `true`:
84	```tsx
85	const [archivedOpen, setArchivedOpen] = useState(false);
86	// Add this effect:
87	useEffect(() => {
88	  if (searchQuery && archivedShows.length > 0) setArchivedOpen(true);
89	}, [searchQuery, archivedShows.length]);
90	```
91	
92	---
93	
94	## Behaviour Summary
95	
96	| Scenario | Result |
97	|---|---|
98	| Type on dashboard | Shows filter in real-time; URL updates (replace) |
99	| Press Enter on dashboard | Same as above but adds to history |
100	| Type + Enter from Calendar/Office Tasks | Navigates to `/?q=term` |
101	| Press Escape anywhere | Clears input, navigates to `/` |
102	| Click × button | Clears input, navigates to `/` |
103	| Navigate to `/?q=foo` directly | Input populates with "foo", shows filtered |
104	| No matches in active, matches in archived | Archived section auto-expands |
105	
106	---
107	
108	## Files Modified
109	
110	- `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/layout.tsx`
111	- `artifacts/show-command-center/src/pages/dashboard.tsx`
112	
113	No API, schema, or backend changes needed.
114	
115	---
116	
117	## Verification
118	
119	1. Start the dev servers (`pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev` + `pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run dev`)
120	2. On dashboard: type a show name fragment — cards filter in real-time
121	3. On calendar page: type a show name + Enter — navigates to dashboard with filtered results
122	4. Clear with × or Escape — all shows return
123	5. Archived shows with matching name auto-expand when searched
124	6. Run existing Playwright tests to confirm no regressions: `pnpm --filter @workspace/show-command-center run test -- tests/features.spec.ts`

# Plan: Preset Tasks Settings Page

## Goal

Add a `/settings` page with a CRUD admin UI so the user can add, edit, and delete preset task templates without touching code. The existing 17 hardcoded presets in `task-list.tsx` are migrated to a `preset_tasks` DB table; `AddTaskDialog` fetches from the API instead of the static array.

---

## Files to Create / Modify

### 1. `lib/db/src/schema/presetTasks.ts` (new)

Drizzle table with columns: `id` (serial PK), `name` (text), `category` (text), `dueDateOffset` (integer nullable), `dueDateUnit` (text nullable — "cal"|"biz"), `dueDateDirection` (text nullable — "before"|"after"), `dueDateAnchor` (text nullable — "moveInDate"|"advanceWarehouseDate"|"onlineOrderDeadline"), `createdAt` (timestamp).

`dueDateOffset = null` means "Manual entry" (no calculated date).

Export `insertPresetTaskSchema`, `InsertPresetTask`, `PresetTask` types.

### 2. `lib/db/src/schema/index.ts` (modify)
Add `export * from "./presetTasks";`

### 3. `lib/db/migrations/0001_preset_tasks.sql` (new, hand-written)
Creates the `preset_tasks` table and seeds all 17 current presets:

| name | category | offset | unit | direction | anchor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Initial Contact Account Executive | Fire Marshal | 60 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Check In / Submit | Fire Marshal | 30 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Hard Deadline | Fire Marshal | 30 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Contact Client / Give Deadline | ID Sign | 30 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| ID Sign Deadline | ID Sign | 12 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Submit Order | ID Sign | 8 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Contact Declared but Not Received | Warehouse Manifest | 3 | biz | before | advanceWarehouseDate |
| Get Bucket Due Dates & Quantities | Show Bucket | 10 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Create Carpet Plan | Show Bucket | 1 | cal | after | onlineOrderDeadline |
| Add CC Tags to XBR List | Show Bucket | 5 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Finalize Carpet Plan | Show Bucket | 5 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Begin Bucket Creation | Show Bucket | 5 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Bucket Due Date | Show Bucket | NULL | NULL | NULL | NULL |
| Send e-Blast for A.E. Vehicle Spotting | Vehicle Spotting | 60 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Check Vehicle Spotting / Provide To Beau | Vehicle Spotting | 40 | cal | before | moveInDate |
| Check Vehicle Spotting / Provide To Beau 2 | Vehicle Spotting | 30 | biz | before | moveInDate |
| Contact Electrical Provider | Electrical | 1 | cal | after | onlineOrderDeadline |

### 4. `lib/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json` (modify)
Add entry `{ "idx": 1, "version": "7", "when": <timestamp>, "tag": "0001_preset_tasks", "breakpoints": true }`.

### 5. `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` (modify)
Add after the `/office-tasks/{taskId}` block:

```yaml
/preset-tasks:
  get: operationId: listPresetTasks, returns array of PresetTask
  post: operationId: createPresetTask, body: CreatePresetTaskBody, returns 201 PresetTask

/preset-tasks/{presetId}:
  put: operationId: updatePresetTask, body: UpdatePresetTaskBody, returns 200 PresetTask or 404
  delete: operationId: deletePresetTask, returns 204 or 404
```

Add schemas: `PresetTask`, `CreatePresetTaskBody`, `UpdatePresetTaskBody`.

### 6. Run codegen
```bash
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen
```
Regenerates `lib/api-client-react/src/generated/api.ts` and `lib/api-zod/src/generated/`.

### 7. `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/presetTasks.ts` (new)
Express CRUD router (same pattern as `officeTasks.ts`):
- `GET /` → select all, ordered by id
- `POST /` → insert with Zod validation
- `PUT /:presetId` → update with 404 guard
- `DELETE /:presetId` → delete with 404 guard

### 8. `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts` (modify)
Add `router.use("/preset-tasks", presetTasksRouter);`

### 9. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/pages/settings.tsx` (new)
Settings page. Structure:
- Page title "Settings" + subtitle
- For each of the 6 categories: a collapsible section listing its presets
- Each preset row: name + computed rule label + Edit (pencil) + Delete (trash) buttons
- "Add Preset" button per category → small inline form or dialog

Rule label computed from structured fields:
- offset=null → "Manual entry"
- offset=N, unit=biz/cal, direction=before/after, anchor=moveInDate/advanceWarehouseDate/onlineOrderDeadline → e.g. "30 biz days before move-in"

Anchor display map: `moveInDate`→"move-in", `advanceWarehouseDate`→"Advance Warehouse", `onlineOrderDeadline`→"Online Order Deadline"

Add/Edit form fields: Name, Category (select), Offset (number, optional), Unit (cal/biz, optional), Direction (before/after, optional), Anchor (select, optional). If Offset is blank → treat as manual.

Uses `useListPresetTasks`, `useCreatePresetTask`, `useUpdatePresetTask`, `useDeletePresetTask` from generated hooks.

### 10. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/layout.tsx` (modify)
Add nav link `<Link href="/settings">Settings</Link>` after "Office Tasks". Import `Settings` icon from lucide-react.

### 11. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/App.tsx` (modify)
Add `import Settings from "@/pages/settings";` and `<Route path="/settings" component={Settings} />`.

### 12. `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/task-list.tsx` (modify)
In `AddTaskDialog`:
- Add `useListPresetTasks` hook (fetches from API)
- Replace hardcoded `presets` array with computed list from API data using `computePresetDate(preset, show)`
- `computePresetDate`: maps structured fields → actual date string using same `subDays`/`addDays`/`subBusinessDays`/`addBusinessDays` logic
- `ruleLabel(preset)`: generates the human-readable rule string from structured fields
- Show loading state while fetching; show "No presets configured. Visit Settings to add some." if list is empty
- The rendered UI (category headers, checkboxes, rule text) stays identical

---

## Key Helper Functions (in task-list.tsx)

```ts
function computePresetDate(preset: PresetTask, show: Show): { date: string; requires: unknown } {
  if (!preset.dueDateOffset || !preset.dueDateUnit || !preset.dueDateDirection || !preset.dueDateAnchor) {
    return { date: "", requires: true }; // manual
  }
  const anchor = (show as any)[preset.dueDateAnchor];
  if (!anchor) return { date: "", requires: null }; // anchor not set
  const anchorDate = parseDateStr(anchor as string);
  const d = preset.dueDateDirection === "before"
    ? (preset.dueDateUnit === "biz" ? subBusinessDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset) : subDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset))
    : (preset.dueDateUnit === "biz" ? addBusinessDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset) : addDays(anchorDate, preset.dueDateOffset));
  return { date: format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd"), requires: anchor };
}

function ruleLabel(preset: PresetTask): string {
  if (!preset.dueDateOffset) return "Manual entry — set due date after adding";
  const anchorMap: Record<string, string> = {
    moveInDate: "move-in",
    advanceWarehouseDate: "Advance Warehouse",
    onlineOrderDeadline: "Online Order Deadline",
  };
  return `${preset.dueDateOffset} ${preset.dueDateUnit} days ${preset.dueDateDirection} ${anchorMap[preset.dueDateAnchor!] ?? preset.dueDateAnchor}`;
}
```

---

## Summary of Changes

| File | Action |
|---|---|
| `lib/db/src/schema/presetTasks.ts` | Create |
| `lib/db/src/schema/index.ts` | Add export |
| `lib/db/migrations/0001_preset_tasks.sql` | Create |
| `lib/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json` | Add entry |
| `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` | Add paths + schemas |
| (run codegen) | Regenerate hooks + Zod |
| `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/presetTasks.ts` | Create |
| `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts` | Register route |
| `artifacts/show-command-center/src/pages/settings.tsx` | Create |
| `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/layout.tsx` | Add nav link |
| `artifacts/show-command-center/src/App.tsx` | Add route |
| `artifacts/show-command-center/src/components/task-list.tsx` | Refactor AddTaskDialog |
